summary: Added fail-fast local-quoted-include dependency preflight to worker_workspace.create_workspace. The _resolve_local_quoted_includes function scans declared C/CUDA/header read inputs for #include "..." directives, recursively resolves them using compiler-style current-directory-then-include-roots lookup, seeds exact live-parent regular files byte-for-byte, deduplicates cycles, and fails closed with exact missing-dependency diagnostics before worker launch. Angle-bracket includes are never followed. Symlink rejection and MAX_SEED_FILES bounds are preserved.
